location.description: pCloud location URI: pcloud://[us|eu|api.pcloud.com|eapi.pcloud.com]/path. Any other host part is treated as the first folder of the path.

access_token.description: pCloud OAuth2 access token (recommended; required for accounts with two-factor authentication)

username.description: pCloud account email (used with password for digest authentication)

password.description: pCloud account password (used with username for digest authentication)

root.description: Absolute path inside pCloud, overriding the path of the location

endpoint.description: Custom API host[:port] for testing against a pCloud emulator (credentials are sent to this host)

insecure.description: Use plain HTTP; only allowed together with a custom endpoint (dangerous; use only for testing)

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stderr

cache_size.description: Memory budget for caching ranged packfile reads (e.g. 64MiB, 1GB, 0 to disable). Nothing is ever cached on disk.
